target_audience: Advanced university students with a strong foundation in calculus and linear algebra.

sections.title: Introduction: The Putnam Mindset
lecture_lines: The Putnam rewards creativity, not brute force.
Focus on core strategies like reduction.
Apply symmetry to simplify complex problems.
Use parity to reveal hidden structures.
Creative proof construction is your goal.
animations: Text 'Focus on Reduction' (#00FFFF) appears, accompanied by [Asset: /scratch/pawsey1357/jthen/Code2Video/assets/icon/hammer.svg].
Text 'Symmetry' (#FF00FF) appears, transforms to simplify alongside [Asset: /scratch/pawsey1357/jthen/Code2Video/assets/icon/mirror.svg].

sections.title: Strategy 1: The Principle of Extremity
lecture_lines: Maximize or minimize the objective function.
animations: Title 'Principle of Extremity' (#00FFFF) fades in using [Asset: /scratch/pawsey1357/jthen/Code2Video/assets/icon/compass.svg].
Plot points (#FFFFFF); highlight max element in (#FF0000).
Animate point set collapsing to boundary (#FFFF00) measured by [Asset: /scratch/pawsey1357/jthen/Code2Video/assets/icon/scale.svg].

sections.title: Strategy 2: Combinatorial Invariants and Parity
animations: Sequence of elements (#FFFFFF) using [Asset: /scratch/pawsey1357/jthen/Code2Video/assets/icon/tiles.svg]; alternate colors based on parity.
Highlight stable invariant property (#FF0000) with flash using [Asset: /scratch/pawsey1357/jthen/Code2Video/assets/icon/chessboard.svg].

sections.title: Strategy 3: Generating Functions and Recurrence
animations: Animate coefficient movement (#FFFF00) to new power using [Asset: /scratch/pawsey1357/jthen/Code2Video/assets/icon/abacus.svg].

sections.title: Synthesis & Summary
lecture_lines: Identify the structure of the problem.
Choose your strategy: invariant or extremity.
Structured exploration always beats brute force.
animations: Final checkmark (#00FF00) appears to confirm completion.
